LESSON: SCANNING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Reading 2.7 Reading for Communication (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand,
Topic 2.9: Scanning for information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Scanning for information, part of Reading 2.7 Reading for Communication (2 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, in Grade 9 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How can we ensure a detailed understanding of a reading text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read out a list of essential facilities found in the locality,

2. look at a map and read out the names of various facilities (e.g. school, church, mosques, market, hospital, etc.),indicated by pictograms

3. listen to and read along audio texts of people talking about locations of different places (z.B. Das Krankenhaus liegt auf der Hauptstraße; Die Kirche liegt hinter dem Markt; Die Schule ist ein Kilometer entfernt; usw),and carry out given tasks

4. read short texts about locations of different places,

5. listen to and read along audio texts of people giving directions using; z.B. nach rechts, nach links, geradeaus,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read out a list of essential facilities found in the locality,
2. look at a map and read out the names of various facilities (e.g. school, church, mosques, market, hospital, etc.),indicated by pictograms
3. listen to and read along audio texts of people talking about locations of different places (z.B. Das Krankenhaus liegt auf der Hauptstraße; Die Kirche liegt hinter dem Markt; Die Schule ist ein Kilometer entfernt; usw),and carry out given tasks
4. read short texts about locations of different places,
5. listen to and read along audio texts of people giving directions using; z.B. nach rechts, nach links, geradeaus,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Scanning for information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: the learner enhances their knowledge when they extract information on amenities and essential

facilities that are represented by pictograms on the area map.

Values:
Patriotism: the learner demonstrates awareness and appreciation for own country when they read texts about essential facilities

in their locality.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Citizenship: the learner develops love for own locality and country when s/he reads out a list of essential facilities found there.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner associates knowledge acquired on facilities found in their community to the same concept learnt in Social studies.
